recognitionRules: Use Rockwell recipe headings with Noto Sans instructions.
Keep ingredients separate from the ordered method.
Make yield and practical preparation notes easy to find.
Use generous white space so the page can be consulted while cooking.
Use rust collection labels and green recipe links, with black recipe headings and roomy ingredient/method areas.

writingLinks.name: Patient coach
writingLinks.reason: Numbered methods and exact portions that a cook can follow.

quote: Something bright for the table. A method you can follow as you cook.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use THE SHARED TABLE in Rockwell with a broad short underline. No fork-and-spoon crest.
invariants: Use Rockwell recipe headings with Noto Sans instructions.
Keep ingredients separate from the ordered method.
Make yield and practical preparation notes easy to find.
adaptations: A recipe card retains yield, ingredients and complete method.
A collection opener may add a short food story without interrupting the recipe structure.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
